title: NBSMusicPlugin
description: A lightweight Minecraft Paper 1.8.8 plugin for playing NBS format music.
body:
A lightweight Minecraft Paper 1.8.8 plugin for playing NBS format music.
Use /music to open the GUI interface and play NBS music conveniently.
For more detailed usage, configuration guides and project updates, please check the open-source GitHub[GitHub](https://github.com/kzy311566/NBSMusicPlugin)
